output.question: Compare the populations of London, Paris, and Berlin

sources.title: List of European cities by population within city limits - Wikipedia

output.findings:
Based on recent estimates for population within city limits, London is the most populous of the three cities, followed by Berlin, and then Paris. As of mid-2024, London's official population is estimated at approximately 9.09 million inhabitants.

Berlin, as of late 2024, has an estimated population of approximately 3.69 million inhabitants within its administrative city boundaries.

Paris has the smallest population among the three when measured strictly by its city limits, with an official estimate of approximately 2.05 million inhabitants as of early 2025. It is important to note that these figures refer to city-proper populations, which can differ significantly from metropolitan area population statistics.
